scientific_scope: The image-object identity, false-positive process, and image-selection process are uncalibrated; this is a conditional proxy, not core evidence.
Alternative Pleiades transport families represent the same image hypothesis and are run separately, never multiplied.
Arbitrary impact positions use a declared nearest 5-NM grid-node discretization after an explicit native-boundary check.
Parent terminal family openap2020-positive-lift-3-targets, contact case r600-no-startup-offset; parent source already includes the cruise, fuel and selected final-contact weights exactly once.

Spatial comparison conditions on computed impacts. Parent incoming mass with uncomputed contact likelihood: 0.1559083456764544; computed impact mass within scored support: 0.9595583763765289. These unresolved masses are not evidence against their locations.
One terminal Monte Carlo seed is used here; its four cruise source populations are already pooled with their recorded effort and normalizers. No new equal-weight pool or legacy handoff is fabricated.
Out-of-support parent mass 0.014200 is removed only by the explicit 'condition_on_native_support' sensitivity condition; it is not evidence against those particles.

No extra likelihood floor is added. Source numerical underflow is preserved and is not evidence of physical impossibility. Floors already present in source observation models remain source assumptions.
This branch is deliberately separate from the parent SATCOM/impact posterior and cannot be stacked with another family representing the same observations.

Conditional weight effective row count is 9.25; it measures concentration, not independent flight ancestry or calibrated uncertainty. Independent numerical repeats are required to assess sampling variation.
